app.title: App Builder
app.subtitle: Describe an app, and a coding agent builds it on this computer.

chats.deleteText: The chat and its history are deleted. The app's files and their git history stay.

agents.heading: Agents
agents.noneReady: No coding agent is ready. Install Claude Code, Codex or opencode, sign in, and check again.

chat.placeholder: Describe the app, or the change you want…
chat.failed: The agent stopped. Send a message to start it again.
chat.emptyText: Describe what the app should do, or the change you want.
chat.inactive: The agent starts with your next message.

mode.label: Permissions
mode.askHint: Edits in the app folder and builds run; everything else asks
mode.autoHint: Also runs commands in the app folder; asks only for what leaves it
mode.warningText: {agent} will no longer ask before it acts, and Studio allows every request.
mode.warningFiles: It can change and delete files anywhere on this computer, not only in the app folder.
mode.warningCommands: It can run any command, with your user's rights.
mode.warningNetwork: It can download and upload data and run code from the internet.
mode.warningScope: Only this chat. Studio switches back to Ask when it restarts.
mode.warningConfirm: I understand that {agent} can do anything on this computer without asking.
mode.active: Unrestricted: {agent} acts without asking, anywhere on this computer.

notice.max_tokens: The agent reached its output limit.
notice.max_turn_requests: The agent reached its step limit.
notice.error: The turn ended with an error.

projects.heading: Apps
projects.removeText: Its chats are deleted. The folder with the app's sources stays on this computer unless you tick the box.
projects.keepsFolder: The folder {folder} stays as it is.

newApp.title: New app
newApp.name: Name
newApp.modelLater: {agent} offers no choice of model; it starts with its own default.
newApp.promptHint: For example: a view for the Digital Nameplate that shows the serial number as a QR code.
newApp.where: Studio creates the app in a folder of its own under Documents/BaSyx Studio/Apps and commits each change the agent makes.
newApp.folderHint: The folder of a Studio app, with its studio-app.json. It stays where it is.
newApp.promptOptional: Optional: the first change you want. Without one, the chat waits for you.
newApp.whereFolder: Studio works in the folder itself. In a git repository, the folder must have no uncommitted changes; without one, Studio creates a repository and commits what is there. Each change of the agent becomes a commit; Studio never deletes this folder.

checkpoint.title: Committed {count} changed files
checkpoint.undoTitle: Undo this turn and the ones after it?
checkpoint.undoText: The app's files go back to how they were before this turn, in a new commit. The agent learns of it with your next message. Nothing is lost: the undone changes stay in the git history.

build.fix: Ask the agent to fix it
build.succeeded: Built. The preview shows the new version.
build.waitsForConsent: Built. The preview waits for your OK in the preview pane.

preview.title: Preview
preview.consentChanged: The new version asks for more
preview.consentText: The preview runs on the target you choose, with your rights, like an installed app.
preview.none: No preview yet. It appears after the agent's next change, or build it now.
preview.noSubmodel: This shell has no submodel for this view.
preview.needsTarget: Choose a target to run the app on.
preview.needsShell: Choose a shell for this part of the app.
preview.needsSubmodel: Choose a submodel this view applies to.

install.title: Install {name}
install.mustRaise: An update needs a higher version than the installed {version}. Studio raises it and commits the change.
install.machineKey: Key {fingerprint}…, trusted by this Studio for local.* apps. Updates need the same key.
install.machineKeyNew: Studio creates this computer's key on first use and trusts it for local.* apps.
install.keyCopied: Public key copied. Another Studio can trust it in its trust store.
install.machineOnlyLocal: This computer's key signs only apps with a local.* ID.
install.keyHint: An ECDSA P-256 private key (PEM), as cosign writes it. Used once, never stored.
install.passphrase: Passphrase, if the key has one
install.unsignedHint: Installs only while developer mode is on, and shows as unsigned.
